mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inquiry_attachments (inquiry_id, storage_key, original_filename, content_type, file_size, created_at) VALUES (#{inquiryId}, #{storageKey}, #{originalFilename}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.inquiry_id, a.storage_key, a.original_filename, a.content_type, a.file_size, a.created_at FROM inquiry_attachments a JOIN inquiries i ON i.id = a.inquiry_id WHERE a.inquiry_id = #{inquiryId} AND i.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY a.id ASC

SELECT a.id, a.inquiry_id, a.storage_key, a.original_filename, a.content_type, a.file_size, a.created_at FROM inquiry_attachments a JOIN inquiries i ON i.id = a.inquiry_id WHERE a.inquiry_id = #{inquiryId} AND a.id = #{attachmentId} AND i.deleted = FALSE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM inquiry_attachments WHERE inquiry_id = #{inquiryId} AND id = #{attachmentId}
